name: San Rafael River (Little Grand Canyon)
gaugeName: San Rafael River near Green River, UT
blurb: Spring-runoff float through the Little Grand Canyon of the San Rafael Swell. Gauge is ~60 river miles downstream of the run.

sections.notes: BLM: float only in small craft above 200 cfs, large craft above 500 cfs; usually floatable only in spring runoff. BLM gives ~18 miles (hike distance). Gauge 09328500 is far downstream - treat timing as approximate.

putInAccess.operator: Bureau of Land Management (Price Field Office)
putInAccess.sourceName: BLM National Recreation Site Points, OBJECTID 68553 'San Rafael River Put In' (Boat Launch, UTG02000 Price FO)
putInAccess.note: BLM National Recreation Site Points, OBJECTID 68553 'San Rafael River Put In' (Boat Launch, UTG02000 Price FO) is the managing agency's own point. Legal boating access: BLM Price FO: Fullers Bottom Trailhead (https://www.blm.gov/visit/fullers-bottom-trailhead): 'Fullers Bottom trailhead serves as the put in for those wishing to hike or float through the Little Grand Canyon ... should only be floated in small crafts above 200 CFS and large crafts above 500 CFS.' Geographic Coordinates 39.1187, -110.8551889. Imagery: Esri World Imagery z19 checked 2026-10-25 (research/raw/imagery/fuller_bottom_san_rafael_put_in.png): the point is where the dirt road ends at the river's edge; the BLM page coordinate is about 30 m east on the same road. NHD flowline 91 m away.
putInAccess.bankSourceName: USGS NHD High Resolution flowline (flow-direction digitized) + Esri World Imagery
putInAccess.bankNote: Facing downstream (flow bearing ~142), the point is left of the NHD centreline (91 m).

takeOutAccess.sourceName: BLM Price FO: Swinging Bridge Trailhead
takeOutAccess.note: Imagery: the BLM GIS point is in the campground loop about 50 m south of the river through trees, with no ramp visible. The BLM Swinging Bridge POI is on the road at the north end of the bridge, and the BLM trailhead page coordinate is about 1.6 km away. Exact take-out is unresolved. Official source names boating access, but the exact water-entry point is not pinned by an agency coordinate confirmed on imagery. Restrictions: runoff-only
takeOutAccess.directions: San Rafael Swinging Bridge (Buckhorn Wash road), BLM Price FO.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.
